showDryMode.title: Show Dry mode switch
showDryMode.description: Uncheck to hide the Dry (dehumidify) switch.

showAutoFan.title: Show Auto Fan switch
showAutoFan.description: Uncheck to hide the Auto Fan switch.

showSwingVertical.title: Show Swing Vertical switch
showSwingVertical.description: Uncheck to hide the Swing Vertical (louver swing) switch.

showForceOff.title: Show Force Off switch
showForceOff.description: Momentary button that sends OFF twice to stop the internal-clean drying fan that keeps running after a normal off. Uncheck to hide it.
